findings.evidence: Lines 20-23 claim the discriminant-bound worked example is realized; lines 29-31 and 103-104 show the proof specializes Mathlib's cyclotomic discriminant formula. The roadmap item at `../roadmap/Completed/EffectiveBounds/README.md:154` specifically says “from the basis `{1, i}`”.
findings.fix: Either change the documentation to say the Q(i) result is obtained from the cyclotomic discriminant formula, or add/document the intended basis/discriminant-bound recovery.
findings.issue: The module doc says this file realizes the roadmap item that “the discriminant bound recovers `|d_{ℚ(i)}| = 4`”, but the actual Q(i) theorem uses `IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.discr_prime_pow_succ`, not the discriminant bound or the basis `{1, i}`.

summary: The new public declarations are documented, but the module documentation overclaims the Q(i) example as an effective discriminant-bound/basis recovery even though the file proves it by Mathlib's cyclotomic discriminant formula.
